name: William Penn
role: Quaker writer; founder, proprietor and governor of Pennsylvania (1681–1718)
summary: A Quaker who defended liberty of conscience and sought government by laws to which the people are party, while treating government as sacred and enforcing Christian morality in his colony. He proposed a binding European parliament to end war and urged plain living and charity for the wealthy.
